name: default_3d_multihead
description: Multi-head 3D nuclear instance segmentation using mask, center, vector-field, and signed-distance predictions.

settings.label: Object diameter (px)
settings.tooltip: Average object diameter in pixels. Typical: small=60, medium=80-100, large=120.

settings.label: Mask threshold
settings.tooltip: Base probability threshold for binary foreground mask. Lower = more sensitive (more cells, more false positives). Higher = stricter (fewer cells, fewer false positives).

settings.label: High mask threshold
settings.tooltip: Voxel-level mask probability threshold for 'definitely cell' classification. The high-mask fraction filter counts what fraction of each instance's voxels exceed this. Real cells have many voxels above 0.96; background has few.

settings.label: Min high-mask fraction
settings.tooltip: Minimum fraction of instance voxels that must exceed the high mask threshold to be kept. Real cells: 30-80%. Background leakage: 0-5%. Raise (0.10-0.15) to remove more false positives. Lower (0.02-0.03) to keep more small cells.
